full_analysis:
## Market Structure & Technical Context

BTCUSD is consolidating above the 80364 key level — the most heavily touched support level across all scanned instruments (11 touches), representing a critical institutional demand zone. Price at 81918 sits above this floor but below the descending EMA20 (82272) and EMA50 (82766), meaning the recovery must navigate through EMA resistance before the 85226 target becomes accessible. The swing high cluster at 84055–84262 represents the primary technical objective and coincides closely with the TP level.

RSI at 39.0% is approaching oversold territory on H4, suggesting downside momentum may be exhausting. ATR at 1102 points reflects very high absolute volatility. The turbulent/impulsive CFD flow (Reynolds=2205.92 — by far the highest across all patterns) indicates this is a high-energy, institutionally contested zone. Momentum is not yet aligned, supporting the slight confidence reduction to 91 — this is a support-hold trade, not a confirmed breakout.

## Key Levels

- **Resistance**: 82272 (EMA20 — first hurdle), 82766 (EMA50 — key trend barrier), 84055–84262 (swing high cluster / TP zone)
- **Support**: 80364 (11-touch structural key level), 80323 (recent swing low), 78711 (algo SL)

## Invalidation Level

An H4 close below 78711 (algo SL) would represent a decisive break of the 80364 support structure, confirming that institutional buyers at this level have been overwhelmed and that a deeper corrective leg is underway.

## Macro & Flow Context

The Quantum Alliance formation and 6.4 million BTC quantum threat narrative creates headline risk but is unlikely to be a near-term price driver. Dollar slippage (European session wrap) provides a mild tailwind for BTC as a risk asset. The extreme Reynolds number (2205.92) confirms this is a heavily contested, high-liquidity inflection zone where large positions are being established.
